Contact Investigation — PracticeA bearing cue will flash briefly on the heading display.
  • The acoustic signature then appears on the waterfall — identify the vessel
  • Click Alpha or Bravo based on the signature
  • The cue usually predicts the vessel identity, but not always
  • Feedback will tell you if you were correct
